clips.title: The story
paras: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon has made a toxin to disrupt the Venture Company's logging in the Stonetalon Mountains. Horde adventurers carry it to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff, who must devise a way to spread it.

Apothecary Lydon made the toxin in the Hillsbrad Foothills to fight the Venture Company loggers despoiling the Stonetalon Mountains. He says the compound is lethal on contact and may spread from one target to another. Before it can be used against the goblins near Windshear Crag, the mixture must cross continents to Thunder Bluff. Apothecary Zamah, the Royal Apothecary Society's representative there, needs the raw toxin to devise a wide-dispersal device called the Toxic Fogger.
